plate_comment: If no fueling state is selected and the variable speed governor is (variable_speed_governor_selected_flag): blends the governor tuning sets, selects FUELING_STATE_VARIABLE_SPEED_GOVERNOR (7), computes the ASG throttle reference and the compensator coefficients, and when it comes from another state loads all_speed_governor_throttle_mode_gain_set (e2m 107B) and its limits into the working governor selection (was cm848_initEngineOperatingMode)

If no fueling state is selected and TSC1 requests speed control (j1939_tsc1_override_state.governor_mode 1): selects FUELING_STATE_TSC1_SPEED_CONTROL with the TSC1 capped speed target and loads the gain set of the requested speed control condition (j1939_tsc1_speed_control_condition_gain_sets) and the J1939 limits and reference filter (was cm848_engineMode_reset)
